Sketched colour polynomials of the ten transactions of section 11 of the post
"Comprehensive Guide to Bottom-k Sketches".  VarOpt sketches, k = 512, as stored
(f32) in /data/bitcoin/2022/colors.sketch-varopt512.zst.  The exponent of x is the
block a coin was minted in; the coefficient is the sketch's estimate of the share of
the transaction's value minted there.  Terms with equal coefficients are grouped,
heaviest first.
